{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items felt like a strong enough match to choose now, although the fasteners reflected some connection to my recent purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Finish nails are not interchangeable with the framing nails I recently explored; the job and equipment compatibility matter more than both being nails.",
    "Locking nuts, hose fittings, and cutting wheels address tasks I have not shown a current need for.",
    "Epoxy and marine sealant require a specific repair or sealing job, and I do not currently have one.",
    "Buying replacement vacuum bags does not mean I need wastebaskets, and buying medicine cups does not mean I need scale-calibration equipment.",
    "Packs of twelve wastebaskets or eighteen rolls of tape exceed what I would choose for an immediate, specific need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in tools and maintenance supplies, when I choose items for particular jobs.",
    "Surface similarities such as fastening, cleaning, or measuring seem to have counted more than whether the recommended item serves the same practical purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated framing-nail purchases suggest that dimensions, collation angle, and tool compatibility deserve close attention, without assuming which equipment I own.",
    "My wood screws and drywall anchors point to specific materials and fastening tasks, rather than a need for any assorted hardware.",
    "The vacuum bags were a replacement for particular Panasonic types; that exact fit matters more than a broad connection to household cleaning.",
    "I need an identifiable current use and a suitable quantity before choosing another supply."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad practical-supplies theme but missed the specific jobs, compatibility, and quantities that determine what I would choose now."
}"}
